description: Run or read the live commit.show audit for a public GitHub repo. Returns a markdown summary by default (paste-ready) or the full JSON envelope when format=json. When the user asks for a project by name (e.g. "audit Supabase"), resolve the canonical github.com/owner/repo URL FIRST — do not guess. The endpoint HEAD-checks GitHub before spending audit budget; an invalid slug returns a not_found envelope.

format.description: Output format. 'md' (default) returns markdown for the user; 'json' returns the full audit envelope.

repo.description: GitHub repo. Accepts a full URL, github.com/owner/repo, or the bare owner/repo slug.

name: audit_repo
